issues.title: Resource capacity / Order of Selection
issues.definition: Program capacity and the current use of Order of Selection when available resources are insufficient to serve every eligible participant.
issues.short_explanation: DVR's official Order of Selection page states that all priority categories closed on Dec. 8, 2025.

timeline.label: DVR closed all priority-of-service categories under Order of Selection.

issues.title: Counselor workload
issues.definition: Caseload size, staffing capacity, and workload conditions affecting case-carrying counselors.
issues.short_explanation: Official DVR planning and needs-assessment materials identify high caseloads and staffing constraints as operational concerns.

issues.title: Staff turnover and continuity
issues.definition: Turnover, vacancies, reassignment, and continuity of case ownership across a participant's DVR episode.
issues.short_explanation: Official DVR needs-assessment material identifies staffing shortages and counselor turnover as significant operational issues.

issues.title: Funding and fiscal pressure
issues.definition: Changes in available program resources, service costs, reimbursement, and demand that affect DVR operating capacity.
issues.short_explanation: DVR's public planning and Order of Selection materials connect service capacity with available resources, costs, caseloads, and demand.

issues.title: Communication reliability
issues.definition: Timeliness and continuity of participant communication, including transitions when cases are reassigned.
issues.short_explanation: Communication and continuity are tracked separately from workload so later data can test whether staffing conditions predict participant communication delays.

issues.title: Qualified-staff pipeline
issues.definition: Recruitment, training, vacancy duration, and retention of qualified vocational rehabilitation staff.
issues.short_explanation: This issue tracks whether staffing shortages are being resolved through hiring, training, and retention rather than treating vacancy counts alone as an outcome.

issues.title: Accessibility and accommodation implementation
issues.definition: Whether program access and requested communication or participation accommodations are implemented consistently.
issues.short_explanation: This domain is tracked separately from legal conclusions so future participant and agency evidence can be compared without assuming every reported barrier establishes a violation.
